Loss report: gitlab -> forgejo
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (hidden) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (extends) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint/step/script script.interpolation: variable prelude (the script reads CI_PROJECT_DIR, which forgejo does not set; a prelude defines them from the forgejo values; forgejo does not expand variable values, so the prelude sets GOCACHE, GOMODCACHE again in the shell)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
